lines.roshan_chapter2_lawn_ready: All my friends are here! Tap the rocket to light our candle.
lines.roshan_chapter2_lawn_arrive: The Ember King and his son are here. They can join our party!
lines.roshan_chapter2_lawn_challenge: The King wants our candle! He is so big. But I can keep my friends safe.
lines.roshan_chapter2_lawn_protect: Move to the green glow. Then tap the King when he sparkles!
lines.roshan_chapter2_lawn_safe: I did it! My friends are safe!
lines.roshan_chapter2_lawn_theft: Oh! The King took our candle! That is not fair.
lines.roshan_chapter2_lawn_leave: The Prince looks sorry. He is leaving with his father.
lines.roshan_chapter2_lawn_hope: My friends are still here. We will find our light together.
lines.roshan_chapter2_lawn_retry: We are safe. Let us try again!
